parameters.content:
## A real production line with the kit as a module
notice → **Kokoro-82M**, three stock voices (local, no cloned person) → **AI Act gate** (Loop Over Items → Execute Sub-workflow, the parent waits for the human) → publish only what was approved. The publishing node is tagged `[exit]` so the registry knows it reaches people. Voices are stock, so this is `synthetic_media`, not a deep fake.

parameters.content:
## AI Act Transparency Kit — deployer side of Article 50, as a module
Two entries: its own intake form, or **Execute Sub-workflow** from any production line (pass asset_type, language, model, prompt, operator, depicts_real_person, public_information, caller_workflow and the file as binary `data`). classify → label + manifest → **Wait-form human gate** (link on the audit view) → approval log → registry of every AI system on this instance with **path analysis**: generator → publishing node, what stands in between. Returns `approved`, `disclosure_status`, `labelled_path`, `disclosed_text` to the caller.

## Sample line — deliberately without a human gate
A typical marketing automation: model drafts, voice is generated, post goes out. Inactive, no credentials. It exists so the Transparency Kit's registry has something to flag: two AI systems, **no human gate**, published text with no disclosure step.

parameters.command: echo '###REGISTRY'; [ -f /data/registry.json ] && cat /data/registry.json; echo; for s in MANIFESTS:manifests APPROVALS:approvals INBOX:inbox; do echo "###${s%%:*}"; for f in /data/${s#*:}/*.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && node -e 'process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8")))+"\n")' "$f"; done; done; true

parameters.content:
## Audit view — what an auditor reads instead of the pipeline
Awaiting a human (gate links) · AI-systems registry with path analysis (Art. 4) · synthetic media & deepfakes (Art. 50(2), 50(4)) · generated public text (Art. 50(4) §2) · approval log (Art. 14, Art. 12 voluntary). Filled from files the kit writes; nothing here is typed by hand.
